name: Raid step 15: two solo runs of The Fractured Archive through its empty rooms, one by the west doors (Ezekiel, Moia, the Dagon'hai Elder) and one by the east (Bork, Dreadnoth, Xarth), each from the Archive Door through the Guardian's hall to Ocellus's room; the transporters and a Passageway back out; the first run out by the reward vault (raid step 28: Travel, its Merit scroll and Rift, the Rift out's Leave), the second by the inner vault's Passageway. The Guardian's, Ezekiel's, Bork and the Smorks', Dreadnoth's, Xarth's and Ocellus's rooms are marked done with ::raid clear (their fights are their own scripts); no other boss is built yet, so each other room is done as it begins
